name: Kajiwara Kagetoki
source:
Warlord of the Kamakura clan, a powerful family in Sagami Province.
He was initially on the side of the Heike, but later followed Yoritomo and became a valued member of his entourage.
After joining the army to defeat the Heike, he also acted as a watchdog for Shanao, with whom he was assigned to work.
He is always scheming, and it is difficult to read what he is thinking.
